content.text:
I submitted **index 25 (Co 0.19 / Sb 0.81)** as the best composition. All three merit measurements are used; even the best result is small, at 0.0100% EQE. I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase explanations below come from model predictions and were not checked against measured patterns.

| Index | Composition (Co/Sb) | Why I picked it | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 19 | 0.34 / 0.66 | Matches CoSb2O6, which the stability model (MACE) puts at 0 eV/atom above the hull | 0.00052 |
| 6 | 0.76 / 0.24 | Co-rich spinel Co7Sb2O12, 0.03 eV/atom above the hull | −0.0015 (no photoanodic response) |
| 25 | 0.19 / 0.81 | The Gaussian-process model's suggestion, after only the Sb-rich side had given a positive signal | **0.0100** |

Index 25 gave about 20 times the EQE of index 19, so the photoactivity seems to rise toward the Sb-rich end of the line. That region is probably CoSb2O6 mixed with an Sb oxide.

With three data points, I can't say where the peak is. It could sit further toward pure Sb (indices 26–29) or between 19 and 25, and neither stretch was measured. The band-gap model (MEGNet) predicted 0.37 eV for CoSb2O6 and 1.44 eV for the spinel, but the measurements didn't track those predictions, so they gave little guidance.
